title: Godot Throws "The file version '16' is unsupported" Error After Modifying sln Format Version
body:
### Tested versions

4.6-stable

### System information

Windows11

### Issue description

After manually modifying the Format Version of the auto-generated Konado.sln file from 12.00 (Visual Studio 2012) to 16.00 (Visual Studio 2019/2022) for high-version VS compatibility, launching the Godot Mono editor and loading the C# project triggers persistent AggregateException errors in the editor output panel. The core inner exception is a Microsoft.VisualStudio.SolutionPersistence.Model.SolutionException stating The file version '16' is unsupported, which causes the Godot C# editor plugin to fail loading and breaks all C# project integration functionality (e.g., script compilation, VS linkage).

### Steps to reproduce

- Create/Open a Godot Mono C# project (Godot auto-generates Konado.sln with Format Version 12.00 and # Visual Studio 2012 comment).
- Manually edit the Konado.sln file with a text editor:
- Change the first line from Microsoft Visual Studio Solution File, Format Version 12.00 to Microsoft Visual Studio Solution File, Format Version 16.00.
